data.body: **[P2] Preserve ordinary `ExecutionException` identity at invocation boundaries.** This removes every `ExecutionException` with a cause, but the new call sites can receive exceptions thrown directly by user handlers or custom SerDes implementations. Previously only CompletableFuture's `CompletionException` transport was removed, so a sneaky-thrown application `ExecutionException` now reports and serializes its cause instead, changing the durable error type and message. Unwrap `ExecutionException` only when detecting a nested fatal error, retain completion-only normalization for nonfatal failures, and add direct handler and SerDes regression tests.
